$description: Durations in ms. Curves are cubic-bezier control points (Flutter Cubic(a,b,c,d)). When Android 'remove animations' / MediaQuery.disableAnimations is on, use the reducedMotion values.

buttonPress.effect: translate by shadow offset, shadow to none

stampIn.effect: scale 1.6 to 1, opacity 0 to 1, final rotation -6deg

carbonIn.effect: carbon sheet slides up from bottom edge to cover paper; private content fades in over last 140ms

carbonOut.effect: private content removed first (same frame), then carbon sheet slides down to uncover paper

ticketReveal.effect: seal strip lifts off (translate up 24, fade); secret content fades in only after the seal is gone (last 120ms)

ticketHide.effect: secret content is removed from the tree in the same frame as the acknowledgement; only the empty sealed ticket animates out

screenPush.effect: new screen slides in from the left edge in RTL (Flutter default RTL page transition), 24px + fade

listItemIn.effect: fade + 8px rise, stagger per item, max 6 items staggered

selection.effect: border/ fill change + check stamp scales in

voteTally.effect: vote stamps appear one at a time per ballot, 160ms apart

winnerReveal.effect: result stamp slams in, then headline rises

privacyRules: No animation may render the secret word, category or role outside the fully revealed state.
No hero/shared-element transitions on private screens.
No decorative looping animation on handoff screens.
Sounds on private screens must be identical for Civilian and Impostor.
